name: Xrrxrax

facts.text: Xrrxrax: level 36, an ixthiar body (model 686), faction Ixthiar Swarm, at about 402,600/330,600 among the ixthiar clippers of Vigilant Rock's south; respawn 600 seconds.
Living Server lore: Xrrxrax as the swarm's scout north of the Vale.

story:
The ixthiar swarm rose out of the ash of Gleann Glas, in the Vale of Balor, and it spreads. Its clippers have come north into the southern edge of Vigilant Rock, and with them a larger one the Necht Sylvan call Xrrxrax, for the sound its mandibles make. The Domnann wardens say it is the swarm's scout, the first of the brood sent north to find out what the rock will feed, and that the Ixthiar Broodmother in the vale knows everything it learns.

The wardens kill it when they can, and it comes back, and each time it comes back a little further north. Necht keeps a stake in the ground where it was last seen. The stakes make a line toward the village. The Domnann wardens are not sure whether the swarm is coming for Necht or for the Watchers. They say it may not know either, and that a swarm goes where it is fed.
legend: Xrrxrax (36) is a named ixthiar among the ixthiar clippers (28-30) on the south side of Vigilant Rock (about 403k/331k). Easy for a group of mid 30s. 10-minute respawn. It belongs to the same swarm as the Vale of Balor's Broodmother and Monger. Plain spawn with no script. The clippers around it are social with it. A group of mid 30s is fine; this is a good warm-up before the dervish woods to the north.

death: (the mandibles click once more and stop)
